page.description: IPFire editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A hardened Linux firewall distribution for a dedicated box: stateful firewall, intrusion prevention, VPN server and a web admin interface, installed from one image.
pros: Purpose-built firewall: IPS, VPN (IPsec and OpenVPN), proxy and DNS in one admin UI.
Small install (around 700 MB) that runs on modest x86_64 or ARM hardware.
Regular core updates on a published schedule.
Separate flash image for ARM boards and SD cards.
cons: Not a desktop or general-purpose system: it is an appliance OS.
The publisher ships BLAKE2 sidecars only, so the SHA-256 values here were computed by ROMinit.
Requires at least two network interfaces for a useful router setup.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for IPFire; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick or the .img.xz to an SD card with dd or any image writer; writing erases the whole device. The installer then sets up the network interfaces and partitions the disk.
